question: Admit this POC to run one independent verification of PR #440's Mermaid sequence companion at cfb804d, so the journey map can use Mermaid?

artifacts.summary: The committed seed is the reviewed artifact: backlog is the initial stage, so no prior stage report exists. PR #440 adds addSequencePage, @tldraw/mermaid 5.4.0, sequence-smoke.mjs and references/sequence.md, and no check in this repository touches any of it — kc-journey-map-tests.yml is server- and model-side only, tsconfig is never invoked, package.json has no build or typecheck script, and the browser smoke needs agent-browser plus hand-started services. Every validation line in the PR body is author-run. This POC runs the checks once at the pinned head cfb804d and reports a receipt; CI wiring was removed from the first draft when the Captain selected POC and is carried as a residual. AC-1..AC-5 cover typecheck with a falsifying mutation, production bundle plus measured Mermaid chunk weight, the seven-assertion browser smoke on isolated services, three tldraw/@tldraw-mermaid symbols cited by symbol, and the SKILL.md dropped-trigger disposition.
